ABOUT SOCIAPI

Ideas become skills.
Skills become solutions.

Sociapi Society is a student-led AI and technology community connecting students across universities in Pakistan.

We help students turn ideas into practical skills, real projects, and career opportunities.

WHAT WE LEARN AND BUILD

Artificial IntelligenceGenerative AIMachine LearningDeep LearningRoboticsProgrammingData ScienceData AnalysisWeb DevelopmentOpenCVEmerging technologies

WHAT WE DO

A community designed for learning by doing.

  1. 01Workshops, seminars, training sessions, and technical events
  2. 02Real projects and stronger student portfolios
  3. 03Learning and study groups for practical skill development
  4. 04Teamwork, problem solving, and innovation
  5. 05Connections with mentors, industry professionals, and opportunities
  6. 06Support for exploring modern technology and career paths

VISION

To build a connected and skilled student technology community where ideas become skills, and skills become real-world solutions.

MISSION

  • Make technology education simple, practical, and accessible
  • Give students opportunities to learn by doing
  • Build a strong network of student tech communities
  • Encourage innovation, collaboration, and project-based learning
  • Connect students with industry, mentors, and career opportunities

FOUNDER / PRESIDENT

Muhammad Zuhair Zeb

Muhammad Zuhair Zeb is from Swabi, Pakistan, and studies Artificial Intelligence at Islamia College University Peshawar. He founded Sociapi Society as a student-led platform for technology, creativity, practical skills, and community leadership.

Sociapi began at one campus and grew through events, programs, and students willing to lead in their own universities.
